message: Hi, I'm a student with a r programming certification background. My overall academic average is 75.9% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in networks and developer. I want to become a CRM Technical Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 1600 per year. I live in Chennai. I'd strongly prefer to stay near home, though I might consider elsewhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
explanation:
This program is located in Hyderabad, which is a reasonable alternative to Chennai. It has a low tuition fee ($1200) that meets your budget constraint and offers strong placement potential with a median starting salary of $14917.

Located in Kolkata, this MSc program has a very low tuition fee ($1200) and is highly relevant to software development. It also boasts a solid placement rate (86%) and an acceptable median starting salary of $12855.

This is the best option for staying near home in Chennai. It requires a CS background (which you have) and has a moderate tuition fee ($1550). The program focuses on software engineering, aligning well with your developer interest.

Also located in Hyderabad, this MBA program combines IT management and software engineering. Its tuition ($1250) is within budget, and the curriculum aligns with your interest in both development and networks/management.

This PG Diploma in Systems Administration focuses on IT support and networking, which directly addresses your interest in 'networks.' The tuition ($1450) is manageable, and the placement rate (87%) is strong for a technical role.
